script.title: CHOOSING A HOUSEPLANT
script.scene_zh: 植物店 · 挑選好養的盆栽
script.story_hook: A new plant buyer wants something that survives.
script.intro_zh: 第一次買植物的人，想找一種養得活的。
script.welcome_en: Hey friends, welcome back! Today we're choosing a houseplant.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，朋友們，歡迎回來！今天我們來挑一盆植物。
script.outro: That's one plant, homed! Listen again and repeat with me.
script.outro_zh: 一盆植物到家啦！再聽一次，跟著我唸。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat the plant shop questions now.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們跟讀植物店裡會問的句子。
script.char_a_description: a friendly young man in his mid-twenties with curly dark hair and wide round eyes, wearing a cream corduroy overshirt and cuffed chinos, holding up his phone with a cat photo
script.char_b_description: a warm woman in her mid-thirties with long braided black hair and gold hoop earrings, wearing a moss-green apron over a white tee, misting leaves with a spray bottle
script.youtube_title: 【🪴🐱選植物英文】「impossible to kill」怎麼說？光線、澆水、寵物安全一次搞懂｜🎧Houseplant Shopping English
script.youtube_title_en: "Impossible to Kill" — Choosing a Houseplant for a Low-Light Apartment
script.youtube_description:
家裡光線暗、還有貓咪，植物到底怎麼挑？這段植物店裡的對話，教你描述光線、問澆水頻率、確認對寵物安不安全。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完就會自己挑。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Dark apartment, curious cat, and you want one plant that lives? This plant shop conversation teaches you to describe light, ask about a watering schedule, and check if a plant is pet safe. 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA and Traditional Chinese, then a repeat-after-me section.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🪴選盆栽英文｜說光線・問澆水頻率・確認寵物安全｜聽完就會養｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
在家想養一盆植物，卻怕養死？
「光線不太夠」用英文怎麼描述？
澆水頻率和寵物安全，又該怎麼問？

這一集帶大家走進一間潮濕綠意的植物店，跟著新手顧客從說明屋裡的光線、確認家裡有貓，到聽懂澆水間隔、挑到有排水孔的花盆，全程都是自然的日常美式英語。

你會聽到：
🌤️ 描述環境：例如「How much light does your place get?」、「One small north window.」。
💧 問照顧方式：例如「Does that need much water?」、「Every three weeks, maybe four in winter.」。
🐾 安全與配備：例如「those aren't pet safe.」、「pick one with a drainage hole, please.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把植物店裡的對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次想幫家裡添一抹綠，你就能自己問、自己挑，安心養下去！
script.thumbnail_action: holding a leafy snake plant beside a phone photo of a cat

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I kill plants. Can you help with that?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ kɪl plænts kæn ju hɛlp wɪð ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我養什麼都死，你可以幫我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, sure. How much light does your place get?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ʃʊr haʊ mʌtʃ laɪt dʌz jɔr pleɪs ɡɛt/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，當然可以。你家裡光線怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not much, honestly. One small north window.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt mʌtʃ ˈɑnəstli wʌn smɔl nɔrθ ˈwɪnˌdoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 老實說不多，只有一個小北窗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay. Any pets around? Cats love to chew.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈɛni pɛts əˈraʊnd kæz lʌv tə tʃu/
dialogue.zh: 好。家有養寵物嗎？貓咪很愛亂咬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One cat, and yes, she chews everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kæt ænd jɛz ʃi tʃuz ˈɛvriθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 養了一隻貓，而且牠什麼都咬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we skip lilies; those aren't pet safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi skɪp ˈlɪliz ðoz ˈɑrənt pɛt seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 那百合就跳過，那些對寵物不安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good point. What works in low light, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd pɔɪnt wʌts wɜrks ɪn loʊ laɪt ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 有道理。那光線不足的話，哪種適合？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A snake plant is nearly impossible to kill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə sneɪk plænt ɪz ˈnɪrli ɪmˈpɑsəbəl tə kɪl/
dialogue.zh: 虎皮蘭幾乎是養不死的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Does that need much water?
dialogue.zh: 不錯。它需要澆很多水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every three weeks, maybe four in winter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri θri wikz ˈmeɪbi fɔr ɪn ˈwɪntər/
dialogue.zh: 三週澆一次，冬天可能四週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That I can remember. Is it a tall one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt aɪ kæn rɪˈmɛmbər ɪz ɪt ə tɔl wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 這個我記得住。它會長很高嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About two feet. This pothos also does well.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt tu fit ðɪs ˈpɒθˌoʊz ˈɔlsoʊ dʌz wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 大約兩英尺高。這盆綠蘿也很好養。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hanging one? Is that safe for cats?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈhæŋɪŋ wʌn ɪz ðæt seɪf fɔr kæts/
dialogue.zh: 就是吊掛的那種？那個對貓安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, pothos can upset a tummy a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ˈpɒθˌoʊz kæn ʌpˈsɛt ə ˈtʌmi ə ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，綠蘿會讓貓咪肚子不太舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then snake plant it is. Do you sell pots?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn sneɪk plænt ɪt ɪz du ju sɛl pɑts/
dialogue.zh: 那就決定虎皮蘭。你們有賣花盆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, pick one with a drainage hole, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pɪk wʌn wɪð ə ˈdreɪnɪdʒ hoʊl pliːz/
dialogue.zh: 有的，請挑一個附排水孔的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Do I need special soil at the counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn du aɪ nid ˈspɛʃəl sɔɪl æt ðə ˈkaʊntər/
dialogue.zh: 選好了。我在櫃台要買特別的土嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One bag, then water it once today. Easy!
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bæɡ ðɛn ˈwɔtər ɪt wʌns təˈdeɪ ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 一包土就夠，今天先澆一次水。超簡單！
